name: Yamanouchi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yamanouchi town emblem in white: an outlined cog-like ring enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Yamanouchi, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Yamanouchi town emblem — an outlined cog-like ring enclosing a ring with a stylised character
